meta.notes: Rebuilt 2026-09-06 directly from eBay's own page text (fetched with requests+BeautifulSoup, not an AI paraphrase) so every anchor_text below is a genuine verbatim substring of the live page -- the fee_checker's exact-match test only works if that holds. Categories marked verified:false, or with a null tier, aren't individually broken out by eBay for that tier and fall back to the 'most_categories' rate as a labeled estimate. Categories not modeled at all (most of eBay's long tail) also fall back to 'most_categories' -- see README for the full list of what's covered.
